items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All four ACs have tests on real run_configs walked to the changelog task: a waiting result leaves the task in_progress, the run not complete and no deploy task; next answers waiting with the link; a confirmed resume re-dispatches the same task; a later ok plans deploy, or completes the run with deploy_target none; 930 shipwright-run tests green, F0 18 units green.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every refusal writes nothing: stale version or session (exit 2), task not open, waiting_phase_mismatch, an unreadable loop state (fail closed), an override of a waiting result (override_requires_ok_result); a malformed waiting block is invalid_result.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The PR link is a plain https URL with a host (no space, control or escape character), re-checked by the Stop hook before printing; it is printed as data; no schema or permission change.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 29 tests in test_single_session_waiting.py assert outcomes on real lifecycle state (task status, phase_tasks, loop state, events), incl. replay after resume, recover, ask_human precedence, CLI exit codes and the hook in-process and as a subprocess.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra small JSON read of the loop state in resolve_next_dispatch; nothing on the dispatch path otherwise.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The three beats live in a new 147-line single_session_wait.py so single_session_apply.py (297) and single_session_recovery.py (279) stay under 300; the marker reuses the gateTerminal keying via loop_state._current_marker.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Phase-runner result JSON (producer: phase-runner, consumer: single-session-apply) and run_loop_state.json (producer: apply/resume, consumers: next, resume card, master Stop hook) round-tripped in the CLI and hook tests, incl. a hand-edited unsafe link and an unreadable version.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No skips, no .only, no mocks of the code under test; the observability tuple test was extended, not loosened.
